money: decimal string with exactly two fractional digits; workspace currency must match

rules: Resolve store and SKU in workspace; both active at validation and recheck at commit.
Duplicate logical keys within a file are errors, even if the values match.
Future business dates are invalid; explicit zero rows establish zero sales.
Reject unsupported negative sales or currency mismatch; never infer a currency.
Resolve active location and SKU; do not create them implicitly.
Duplicate logical keys within a file are errors.
Future timestamps beyond five-minute clock tolerance are invalid.
Normalize CASE using product.case_units frozen at import and retain raw unit/quantity.

corrections: Append a new committed batch; latest committed revision wins per logical key.
deduplication: Same workspace/kind/source hash returns existing committed import; repeat commits reuse batch_id.
empty_file: Invalid: require at least one data row; no business data is created on installation.
